messages:
elaine: Hey @calvin @zoe — vendor (HelixHealth) asking for a single compact PO + MSA redline. Need routing for CFO + legal countersign. PO amount $42,000. Can we get legal eyes? :wave:
calvin: Adding procurement. Need to confirm whether we can accept vendor's redline for Section 7.2 (data residency). Any risk? cc @zoe
zoe: Upload the redline and order form pls. If they removed our KMS clause we can't accept. Also need DPA alignment — ask for SOC2 cert date.
elaine: Uploaded: `OrderForm_Helix_0427.pdf` and `MSA_redline_helix.docx`. They want to swap the 'Customer Data' definition and remove subproc restrictions.
jess: Procurement ok with single PO but need invoice terms net45? Sales wants net30. Also need billing contact and EIN.
calvin: We can do net30 for POC; finance will approve if we get a signed MSA. Who signs first? Helix wants us to sign order form then they countersign; legal prefers countersign MSA first.
zoe: Preference: MSA countersigned before PO. If sales must sign order form first, add explicit 'subject to countersignature' clause. I can draft language.
elaine: Customer pushing to use their DocuSign flow. Is that OK with our audit trail? @docsign-bot any known issues with external envelopes?
docsign-bot: DocuSign integration note: external envelopes accepted if `esign.example.com` configured. Audit logs will be captured. Envelope ID: 0a1b2c (placeholder). :white_check_mark:
jess: Also need the signing matrix — who on their side signs? Helix lists 'Director of Ops' only; legal requires an authorized signatory. Request full signatory name and title.
elaine: I asked Helix to provide signatory + EIN. Also asked for SOC2 cert URL and cert date. They responded with a PDF link.
zoe: Quick redline note: change Section 12.4 to keep our indemnity cap at 3x fees. They tried to lower it. Also DPA: require 30 days notice for subprocessor changes.
calvin: OK — next steps: Zoe to prepare MSA amendment patch, Jess to confirm payment terms and EIN, Elaine to collect signer info and send DocuSign envelope with 'subject to countersignature' language.
elaine: Sending envelope now. Envelope ID: 18401-helix-PO. Tagging @jess @zoe. :rocket:
docsign-bot: Envelope 18401-helix-PO sent to helix-sign@helix.com. Status: Sent.
jess: When Helix countersigns, finance needs PDF + PO number to set up invoice. Please ping #billing once countersigned.
elaine: Will do. Heads up — Helix asked if we can expedite signature to meet their month end. Zoe, can you quickreview? If you approve I'll allow sales to sign order form early with clause.
zoe: I'll prioritize, will send redline comments within 2 hours.
elaine: Thanks all. :thumbsup:
